items.title: Add providers/gemini-cli.ts (mirror codex-cli.ts pattern)
items.context: Create packages/main/src/providers/gemini-cli.ts implementing geminiCliAvailable() + runBoundedGeminiProvider() with the SAME contract shape as codex-cli.ts: PATH discovery, spawnSync bounded by timeout, capture stdout/stderr digests + byte counts, exit code, duration, never surface raw output. Reuse shared subprocess types from codex-cli.ts where possible. Smoke equivalent of provider-codex-smoke.ts — provider-gemini-smoke.ts — proving the same 4 cases (success / disabled / timeout / missing binary).
items.userSees: `ls packages/main/src/providers/gemini-cli.ts` shows the new provider file. `node packages/main/dist/tasks/provider-gemini-smoke.js` PASSES the 4-case contract.

items.title: Add runCodexRealLeafDispatch + runGeminiRealLeafDispatch + dispatch switch upgrade
items.context: In packages/main/src/core/lattice-dispatch.ts: add runCodexRealLeafDispatch + runGeminiRealLeafDispatch (mirror runClaudeCodeRealLeafDispatch shape at line 1938). In the dispatch_run switch at line ~2400: when normalized==="codex" AND codexCliAvailable() → branch to runCodexRealLeafDispatch (REAL); when normalized==="gemini" AND geminiCliAvailable() → runGeminiRealLeafDispatch (REAL); when normalized in {codex,gemini} but BOTH CLIs unavailable → fall back to runClaudeCodeRealLeafDispatch with a logged degradation reason. Update the scaffolded-only warning at line 757 to fire only when the REAL path is not taken (i.e. CLI unavailable AND no fallback).
items.userSees: `grep runCodexRealLeafDispatch packages/main/src/core/lattice-dispatch.ts` and `grep runGeminiRealLeafDispatch` each return matches. `grep -E 'codexCliAvailable|geminiCliAvailable' ...` shows the routing conditions. `grep -E 'falling back.*claude-code' ...` shows the fallback message.
